_note: One promise per frame. Headline: '|' breaks the line, *asterisks* mark the run that gets the pill. Max about 4 words. Subline: one short sentence saying where the number or plan comes from. No em or en dashes, no 'AI', no promised centimetres, nothing that says an exercise lengthens bones. Frames 1 to 3 must work alone: they are what search results show.
